title: 名詞與代詞
subtitle: Nouns & Pronouns
summary: 名詞題在多益的比重極高：可數不可數、單複數、冠詞、複合名詞，全部都是送分題——只要規則記得清楚。

blocks.value: 英文把名詞分成可數與不可數，決定了要不要加 s、能不能加 a/an、以及要搭配哪一種數量詞。

rows: many / few / a few / several / a number of
much / little / a little / a great deal of / an amount of
some / any / a lot of / plenty of / most / all
a lot of work / a lot of tasks

blocks.value: 多益高頻的不可數名詞要特別記，它們在中文裡感覺可數，但英文不可數。

items: information 資訊、equipment 設備、furniture 傢俱、luggage 行李、machinery 機械
advice 建議、access 使用權、research 研究、evidence 證據、feedback 意見
merchandise 商品、stationery 文具、clothing 衣物、traffic 交通、permission 許可

items.en: We need more information about the vendor.
items.zh: 我們需要更多關於該廠商的資訊。

items.note: information 不可數，不能加 s 也不能用 many

items.en: We received a great deal of feedback.
items.zh: 我們收到大量意見回饋。

blocks.value: 有些字可數與不可數意思不同：work（工作，不可數）／works（作品、工廠）；paper（紙，不可數）／papers（文件、論文）；experience（經驗，不可數）／experiences（經歷）。

blocks.q: The technician brought all the necessary _____ to the site.
blocks.explain: equipment 是不可數名詞，永遠不加 s，也不加 a/an。

sections.title: 冠詞 a / an / the 與零冠詞

rows: 單數可數、首次提到、泛指一個
雙方都知道、前文提過、獨一無二、最高級、序數
The consultant we hired is excellent.
複數泛指、不可數泛指、專有名詞

blocks.value: a 或 an 看的是「發音」不是拼字：a university（發 /juː/）、an hour（h 不發音）、an MBA（唸 em）。

items.en: She was promoted to a senior position last month.
items.zh: 她上個月被升到資深職位。

items.en: Please submit the report by the end of the day.
items.zh: 請在今天結束前交出報告。

items.en: Access to the building requires an ID card.

blocks.value: 多益常考固定搭配的冠詞：in the morning / at night（無 the）、on time（準時）vs in time（及時）、in charge of、on average、in advance。

blocks.q: _____ number of applicants has increased significantly this year.
blocks.explain: the number of + 複數名詞 = 「…的數量」，動詞用單數；a number of = 「許多」，動詞用複數。這裡動詞是 has，所以選 The。

blocks.value: 兩個名詞連在一起時，前面那個當形容詞用，通常保持單數。多益很愛考這類「名詞＋名詞」的搭配。

items: application form 申請表、customer satisfaction 顧客滿意度、safety regulations 安全規範
expiration date 到期日、performance review 績效考核、production facility 生產廠房
sales representative 業務代表、job opening 職缺、travel expenses 差旅費用

items.note: application 當形容詞用，保持單數

items.en: All sales representatives must submit travel expenses monthly.
items.zh: 所有業務代表必須每月提交差旅費用。

blocks.value: 空格前面已經有形容詞時，答案通常是名詞而不是另一個形容詞：a comprehensive _____ → 名詞。但若空格在兩個名詞之間，仍可能要形容詞，要看語意。

blocks.q: The company offers competitive _____ packages to attract talent.
blocks.explain: packages 是名詞，前面需要一個名詞當修飾語構成複合名詞 compensation packages（薪酬方案）。

sections.title: 人稱代詞、所有格與反身代詞

blocks.value: 主詞位置用主格，動詞或介系詞之後用受格，名詞前面用所有格形容詞，名詞後面單獨使用用所有格代名詞。

items.en: The award was given to her and me.
items.note: 介系詞 to 之後用受格
介系詞 between 之後要用受格 me

items.en: The decision is theirs to make.

blocks.value: its（它的，所有格）和 it's（it is / it has）在多益常互換設陷阱。其次是 their / there / they're。

blocks.q: Employees should submit _____ timesheets by Friday.
blocks.explain: timesheets 是名詞，前面要用所有格形容詞 their。

sections.title: 不定代詞與 one / it / that 的替代

rows: Each of the reports is complete.
Both of the proposals are viable.
Most of the budget has been spent.

blocks.value: 避免重複名詞時，可數單數用 one / ones，不可數或整件事用 it / that / those。

items.en: This printer is faster than the one on the second floor.
items.zh: 這台印表機比二樓那台快。

items.en: The revenue of this quarter exceeds that of last year.
items.zh: 本季營收超過去年同期。
items.note: that 代替不可數的 revenue

items.en: The costs in Asia are lower than those in Europe.

blocks.q: Neither of the candidates _____ the required certification.
blocks.explain: Neither of + 複數名詞，動詞仍用單數 has。
